items.title: Intuit beats first-quarter estimates, agrees to sell Mailchimp for $3.68 billion
items.summary: Investing.com -- Intuit reported stronger-than-expected first-quarter results on Thursday, as growth in its QuickBooks and consumer businesses helped offset weaker revenue at Mailchimp, while the financial software company agreed to sell the email marketing platform to Italy’s Bending Spoons for approximately $3.68 billion.

items.title: Intuit Stock Tumbles After Earnings Beat. It’s Selling Mailchimp.
items.summary: Intuit reported better-than-expected fiscal first-quarter earnings.

items.title: Intuit to Sell Mailchimp for $3.68 Billion
items.summary: The company posted a higher profit and revenue in the fiscal first quarter, and agreed to sell its email automation platform Mailchimp to Bending Spoons.

items.title: Bending Spoons to Buy Marketing Platform from Intuit as It Beats Expectations
items.summary: The company also disclosed a $1.3 billion private share sale.

items.title: Intuit Beats Fiscal Q1 Goals, Gives Soft Outlook, Sells Mailchimp
items.summary: Financial software firm Intuit beat Wall Street's estimates for its fiscal first quarter but missed with its outlook.

items.title: Intuit (INTU) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Top Estimates
items.summary: Intuit (INTU) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +18.29% and +1.14%, respectively, for the quarter ended October 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: Intuit earnings setup: What could push INTU stock higher today
